Oversight Board
MINUTES
LA PUENTE OVERSIGHT BOARD
REGULAR MEETING OF
April 26, 2012
A Regular Meeting of the Oversight Board of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on April 26, 2012, at 3:00 p.m.
Members Present:
Manuel Baca, Gary Matsumoto, Ward Komers, Raul Alvarez, and Charlie Klinakis.
Staff Members present:
None.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - None.
1.
SELECTION OF CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR
Gary Matsumoto moved to Charlie Klinakis as Chair ; seconded by 0.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Manuel Baca, Gary Matsumoto, Ward Komers, Raul Alvarez, and Charlie Klinakis. NOES: None.
Raul Alvarez moved to Gary Matsumoto as Vice Chair. ; seconded by 0.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Manuel Baca, Gary Matsumoto, Ward Komers, Raul Alvarez, and Charlie Klinakis. NOES: None.
2.
APPROVAL OF RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE (January 1, 2012 through June 30, 2012, and July 1, 2012 through December 31, 2012)
OB Staff Report -- ROPS
OB Staff Report -- ROPS Exhibit A
OB Staff Report -- ROPS Exhibit B
OB Resolution -- adopting ROPS Attach 1
Ward Komers moved to Resolution No. 01 adopting the Recognized Obligation Schedule (ROPS) for the time periods covering January 1, 2012 through June 30, 2012. ; seconded by Manuel Baca.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Manuel Baca, Gary Matsumoto, Ward Komers, Raul Alvarez, and Charlie Klinakis. NOES: None.
Ward Komers moved to It is recommended that the Board approve the attached resolution adopting the Recognized Obligation Schedule (ROPS) for the time periods covering July 1, 2012 through December 31, 2012. ; seconded by Manuel Baca.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Manuel Baca, Gary Matsumoto, Ward Komers, Raul Alvarez, and Charlie Klinakis. NOES: None.
3.
SELECTION OF FUTURE MEETING DATES
Ward Komers moved to May 24, 2012 at 3:00 p.m. as the next meeting date. ; seconded by Charlie Klinakis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Manuel Baca, Gary Matsumoto, Ward Komers, Raul Alvarez, and Charlie Klinakis. NOES: None.
4.
ADOPTION OF BYLAWS AND RULES OF PROCEDURE FOR THE OVERSIGHT BOARD
OB Staff Report -- Bylaws and Rules of Procedure
BYLAWS of Oversight Board
RULES OF PROCEDURE of Oversight Board
OB Resolution -- Bylaws and Rules of Procedure Attach 1
Ward Komers moved to Resolution No. 12-02 adopting the Bylaws and Rules of Procedure. ; seconded by Gary Matsumoto.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Manuel Baca, Gary Matsumoto, Ward Komers, Raul Alvarez, and Charlie Klinakis. NOES: None.
5.
DESIGNATION OF POINT OF CONTACT WITH DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE
Raul Alvarez moved to Designate Executive Director Bret Plumlee as the Point of Contact with the Department of Finance. ; seconded by Charlie Klinakis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Manuel Baca, Gary Matsumoto, Ward Komers, Raul Alvarez, and Charlie Klinakis. NOES: None.
A.
